meta.name: summarize-interview
meta.description: Summarize a customer interview transcript into a structured template with JTBD, satisfaction signals, and action items. Use when processing interview recordings or transcripts, synthesizing discovery interviews, or creating interview summaries.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将客户访谈转录为结构化摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从客户访谈中提炼洞察和行动项。
copy.tagline_en: Summarize customer interview transcripts into structured insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract insights and action items from customer interviews.

howto.what: 将客户访谈记录整理成结构化摘要，包含待完成工作、满意度信号和行动项。
howto.when: 当你提供访谈录音或文字记录，或要求总结发现性访谈时触发。

say.text: 帮我总结这段客户访谈记录。
say.note: 技能会提取关键信息并生成模板化摘要。

say.text: 整理这份访谈，列出待完成工作和行动项。
say.note: 技能会按模板输出结构化内容。

howto.what_en: Summarizes a customer interview transcript into a structured template with Jobs to Be Done, satisfaction signals, and action items.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an interview transcript or recording, or ask to synthesize discovery interviews.

say_en.text: Organize this interview with JTBD and action items.
